verdict.rationale: BILL documents custom approval policies and bill approval policies that control which bills need approval, by whom, and when. That evidence covers AP bill approvals, not expense or spend requests. Nothing shows multi-level chains, delegation, or escalation. Missing for 10: evidence of multi-step manager/budget-owner/finance approval chains, approver delegation, escalation when approvers sit on requests, Spend & Expense-specific approval workflows, and independent corroboration.
